description: List installed Firefox extensions using the WebDriver BiDi webExtension.moz:listExtensions command.

ids.description: Optional: Filter by exact extension IDs (e.g., ["addon@example.com"])

isActive.description: Optional: Filter by enabled (true) or disabled (false) status

name.description: Optional: Filter by partial name match (case-insensitive, e.g., "shopify")

name: list_extensions
